definitions.explanation: The obligation or practice of keeping information private, especially in professional or legal settings.

examples.japanese: {守秘|しゅひ}⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an obligation of confidentiality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}→個人情報：18842_kojinjouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{守秘|しゅひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Confidentiality of personal information is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かん}する→関する：02045_kansuru⟧{守秘|しゅひ}⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{課|か}されて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Doctors are bound by a duty of confidentiality regarding patient information.

notes:
Refers to keeping information secret or confidential, especially in professional or legal contexts. A compound of {守|しゅ} (protect) and {秘|ひ} (secret). Most commonly encountered in the compound {守秘|しゅひ}⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧ (duty of confidentiality).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {守秘|しゅひ}⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧: duty of confidentiality; NDA obligation
- {守秘|しゅひ}⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧: confidentiality agreement; NDA
- {守秘|しゅひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{徹底|てってい}する→徹底する：21452_tetteisuru⟧: to ensure strict confidentiality
- {守秘|しゅひ}⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧: confidential matters

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{機密|きみつ}→機密：13179_kimitsu⟧: classified information; secrecy
- ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧: secret — more general and everyday
- ⟦{極秘|ごくひ}→極秘：13162_gokuhi⟧: top secret
